seo.title: Rocío Landó — Illustrator & Graphic Artist
seo.description: Rocío Landó is an illustrator and graphic artist drawing the unseen — fine-line ink studies and watercolour sketches of architecture, travel, animals and the botanical world.

headline: Drawing
the unseen.
hero.intro: Fine-line ink and watercolour studies of the places I wander through — the crooked rooftops, the quiet creatures, the things most people walk straight past.

about.heading: I collect places the way other people collect postcards — one pen stroke at a time.
paragraphs: I'm Rocío, an illustrator born between the Caribbean light of Curaçao and the grey-blue rooftops of the Netherlands. I work mostly in ink and watercolour, chasing the character in old facades, the posture of an animal, the way a sunflower leans toward a window.

My sketchbooks are travel diaries first and portfolios second. Every building has been stood in front of; every creature watched a while before the nib touched paper. What I'm really after is the *unseen* — the small, overlooked detail that makes a place feel alive.
I take on commissions, editorial work, prints and collaborations. If you have a story that wants a hand-drawn voice, I'd love to hear it.

stats.label: Years with a pen in hand

process.title: Wander & watch
process.text: Every piece starts on foot. I find a corner, sit a while, and let the place reveal its rhythm before I commit a single line.

process.title: Ink the bones
process.text: A fine-liner lays down the architecture — confident, imperfect, alive. No ruler. The wobble is the point.

process.title: Wash the light
process.text: Watercolour comes last and quickly, in a handful of transparent layers, so the white of the paper keeps breathing through.

process.title: Share the page
process.text: Scanned, prepared for print or screen, and sent into the world — as commissions, editorial art, prints and this ever-growing diary.

faqs.q: How long does a custom illustration take?
faqs.a: Most commissions take one to two weeks depending on size and detail. On-location commissions and larger series can take longer — I'll always give you an honest timeline before we begin.
Yes. Every professional collaboration comes with a licensing agreement tailored to where and how the work will be used, from editorial to packaging and print runs.

faqs.q: Can I order a portrait of my own house or pet?
faqs.a: Absolutely — house portraits and animal portraits are some of my favourite commissions. Send me a few clear reference photos and we'll take it from there.

faqs.q: Do you sell prints of existing work?
faqs.a: Many pieces in the gallery are available as fine-art prints and stationery. Tell me which one caught your eye and I'll share sizes and options.

faqs.q: Where are you based, and do you ship?
faqs.a: I split my time between Curaçao and the Netherlands, and I ship originals and prints worldwide with tracked, well-protected packaging.
